title: 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall Mount Glass Shelf With Solid Brass Hardware (Tempered Glass) - Contemporary, Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear countertop clutter and keep daily bathroom essentials easy to grab with a crisp, modern 3-tier glass shelf designed for wall-mount storage.

  • More storage without crowding the vanity — triple tier design organizes toiletries, skincare, and décor in one vertical unit.
  • Made for everyday bathroom use — solid brass hardware supports 3/8-inch thick tempered glass for strength and safety.
  • Clean, minimalist look on the wall — concealed screw mounting hardware keeps installation details out of sight.
  • Easy to coordinate — pairs naturally with modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Overall dimensions: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 15-Inch H
  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8-in), tempered
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Mounting: Wall mount (concealed screw hardware)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size: #8 x 1 1/4)
  • Finishes: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
